title: I had an odd thought. Could we be Remote Viewing in our dreams?
content: It occurred to me just now after thinking about the ridiculous Newsnation interview tonight where they showed the egg video and talked about remote viewing. I’ve known about this topic for a long time, and seen the CIA documents on it. But it never occurred to me to think of Mall World as a remote viewing experience. Could we be controlling otherworldly bodies? Maybe even our different parallel universe selves?
